headline: State Government Files Emergency Appeal After Supreme Court Clerk Accidentally Uses 'Comic Sans' On Official Corruption Inquiry Memo
body: Legal representatives for the state government argued in an emergency filing today that the use of Comic Sans in a federal probe notification renders all subsequent corruption allegations 'stylistically inadmissible' and constitutionally informal. The administration is now seeking an immediate stay of proceedings until the document is reissued in a more authoritative font, preferably Times New Roman at 12-point size.
caption: The court's choice of font has caused more administrative chaos than the actual probe itself. Would you take a legal notice seriously if it was typed like a birthday invitation? #LegalDrama #FontWars #Judiciary #Bureaucracy (satire)
igHook: Would you take a legal notice seriously if it was written in Comic Sans?
imagePrompt: A close-up view of a standard legal document lying on a mahogany desk with a blurry courtroom interior in the background.
